we show that evaluating a sequence of set-manipulation operation can be done in polylogarithmic time using polylogarithmic processors, and that this is essentially optimal.

The main takeaway from our work is that
, in general, the problem of evaluating sequences of set-manipulation operation is not hard, and that, in fact, the problem can be solved in polylogarithmic time using polylogarithmic processors.
